metadata.title: CalcOsPower verified RO/NF membrane catalog
metadata.policy: RO entries remain calculation-enabled only where complete manufacturer test points are verified. NF270-4040 and NF90-400 are calculation-ready through CalcOsPower v18.4 species-selective, charge-balanced salt-pair transport calibrated from manufacturer salt benchmarks; other NF entries remain catalog-only until comparable selectivity data are verified.
metadata.specific_flux_definition: Test flux = nominal permeate flow / active area. A_app is back-calculated from the manufacturer test point using the existing CalcOsPower osmotic-pressure model, concentration polarization and clean-element pressure drop; the validated osmotic coefficient is not replaced.
metadata.notes: v18.4.0 adds calculation-ready species-selective NF90-400 and NF270-4040 transport without applying a single overall-salt rejection to mixed-ion NF feeds.

membranes.nf_selectivity_note: NF270 uses explicit NaCl-like, CaCl2-like, and MgSO4-like transport classes. Permeate ions are recombined on an equivalent-charge basis so the NF salt-pair model remains electrically balanced.
membranes.nf_b_calibration_basis: B values back-calculated from DuPont observed salt rejection at 30 LMH and 10% recovery after the CalcOsPower valence-aware concentration-polarization correction, so feed-to-permeate benchmark rejection is reproduced rather than treating datasheet rejection as membrane-surface rejection.

membranes.application: High-rejection nanofiltration / salts, nitrate, iron and organics removal
membranes.source: User-supplied Dow FilmTec NF90-400 PDS, Form No. 609-00345-0312
membranes.data_basis: User-supplied NF90-400 dual-salt manufacturer test points. A is a least-squares fit to the NaCl and MgSO4 water-flux test points using CalcOsPower multi-ion osmotic pressure; NaCl rejection uses the midpoint of the published 85–95% range and MgSO4 uses the published >97% lower bound conservatively as 97%.
membranes.nf_selectivity_note: NF90 has explicit NaCl-like and MgSO4-like transport classes from the supplied PDS. No mixed-valence salt benchmark is published in that sheet, so mixed-valence pairs conservatively use the lower-rejection NaCl-like B coefficient.
membranes.nf_b_calibration_basis: B values back-calculated from the supplied observed NaCl and MgSO4 salt rejection benchmarks after the CalcOsPower valence-aware concentration-polarization correction. NaCl uses the midpoint of the published 85–95% range; MgSO4 uses 97% as a conservative lower-bound target for the published >97% statement.
membranes.pressure_drop_note: User-supplied legacy PDS publishes 3.4 bar maximum pressure drop across the entire pressure vessel; it does not publish a per-element limit.
